mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO drops > 2% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in one month signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls.

mechanism_narrative: A regime of low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1%) coupled with increasing real estate loans (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1% and RSAFS increases.
